camel_example: aliyun energyexpertexternal POST /api/v2/aidoc/document/submitDocExtractionTask --region cn-hangzhou --fileName 'example.pdf' --templateId 572d24k0c95a --extractType rag --folderId xxxxx --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Extracts key information from a document based on a preset key-value template or prompt template. A successful call returns a task ID. You can then call GetDocExtractionResult to retrieve the extraction results. Asynchronously submits a task for a file specified by a URL. To submit a task for a local file, use the SubmitDocExtractionTaskAdvance operation
description_zh:
用于从文档中提取关键信息，它根据用户预设的Key-Value模板或提示词模板进行信息抽取。
调用成功后返回taskId，后续调用GetDocExtractionResult获取信息抽取结果。
支持本地文件和URL文件两种方式：
URL上传的异步提交服务接口为：SubmitDocExtractionTask接口。
本地文件上传的异步提交服务接口为：SubmitDocExtractionTaskAdvance接口
kebab_example: aliyun energyexpertexternal submit-doc-extraction-task --file-name example.pdf --template-id 572d24k0c95a --folder-id xxxxx --extract-type rag --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitDocExtractionTask

parameters.example:
FileUrl: https://example.com/example.pdf
fileUrlObject: FileInputStream generated from a local file
parameters.help_en:
Choose one of the following parameters: fileUrl or fileUrlObject.

fileUrl: The URL of a single document. The document can have a maximum of 3,000 pages and a size of up to 500 MB.

fileUrlObject: The local file to upload. The document can have a maximum of 3,000 pages and a size of up to 500 MB. This parameter is used when you call the SubmitDocExtractionTaskAdvance operation.

The supported document types vary based on the extraction method.

Long-text retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): Supports PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, and TXT files with a maximum of 3,000 pages.

Image processing: Supports PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, JPE, TIF, TIFF, WEBP, and HEIC files.

Long-text understanding: Supports DOC, DOCX, XLSX, PDF, CSV, and TXT files
parameters.help_zh:
fileUrl/fileUrlObject二选一：

fileUrl：以文档URL方式使用，单个文档（支持3000页以内、500MB以内的文档）

fileUrlObject：以本地文件上传方式调用接口时使用，单个文档（支持3000页以内、500MB以内的文档）

文档抽取方式与支持上传的文档类型的关系
长文本RAG：支持pdf, doc/docx, xlsx, csv, txt，支持3000页
图片处理：支持pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, jpe, tif, tiff, webp, heic
长文本理解：支持doc/docx, xlsx, pdf, csv, txt
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The file name, including the file extension
parameters.help_zh: 文件名需带文件类型后缀
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the extraction template. This ID specifies the content to extract from the document. To obtain a template ID, log on to the template management page and configure a template
parameters.help_zh: 唯一的抽取模板ID，用于指定文档要抽取的内容，需登录模板管理页面配置模板后获取对应的模板ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the knowledge base folder. Use this parameter to categorize documents or to limit the scope of documents for online Q\&A queries.

To obtain a folder ID, log on to the Document Mind console
parameters.help_zh:
唯一的知识库文件夹ID，当需要对文档进行分类管理、控制在线问答查询的文档范围时使用。
文件夹ID需要登录文档智能控制台获取
parameters.name: folder_id

parameters.help_en: The document extraction type. Supported types include rag and long-text understanding. The default value is rag
parameters.help_zh:
文档抽取类型：
支持rag、长文本理解类型，默认rag
parameters.name: extract_type
